description: Send one of the project's secrets to where the app runs — Cloudflare Workers or Pages, Vercel, Convex, Fly.io, Railway, Firebase Functions, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Google Cloud Secret Manager, Koyeb, Fastly, Pulumi or SST — through that host's own CLI, with the value on its standard input. The value never passes through you or a command line, and hush refuses a value the host's CLI would change. The user approves each push. Use this instead of telling the user to paste a key into a dashboard, and instead of `sh -c '... | wrangler secret put'`.

as.description: A different name for it there. Default: the key's own name.

deploy.description: Fly and Railway only: deploy as part of setting it. Default: stage it for the next deploy.

env.description: The host's environment, stage or deployment, e.g. 'production' for Vercel.

target.description: Which Worker, Pages project, app, repository, project, stack or store. Omit to use the one the project's own config names (wrangler.jsonc, fly.toml, .firebaserc), where it has one.

name: hush_push
